bounds.explanation: 115x300=575 nominal input-minutes. At most15seconds cleanup per input adds28.75minutes; the635-minute sum leaves31.25minutes across setup and upload reserves. Every job starts its internal monotonic clock in its first step. If setup uses too much allowance, stop before launching an input without the full300seconds plus cleanup. Queue time is outside measured input/job execution and does not grant scan time.

environment: Three dependent standard ubuntu-latest jobs in one workflow_dispatch, each pinned to scanner1f3f72f with Python3.12, uv0.8.22 and identical uv.lock. Record actual Python patch, package versions, CPU/topology, memory/load and source/workflow identities for each job. No larger, self-hosted or paid runner; no overlapping owned timing work. Separate physical hosts are disclosed; comparison is report determinism and per-host completion, not physical-host speed equivalence.
implementation_included_if_approved: Prepare a versioned workflow and minimal extension of the already validated v20 supervisor to the existing Phase22/Phase20 measure() and frozen manifest paths. Normal CI jobs remain unchanged. Bind exact workflow/runner/gate/configuration/assessment hashes in a pre-dispatch receipt. No scanner source or deadline monkeypatch.

Retain the existing development/historical condition rules. Existing condition-assessment JSON bytes remain fixed; verify matching candidate identity on each output before scoring. All new/changed unrelated findings, warnings and coverage receive source assessment using retained bytes, without extra scans.

Each isolated child uses production rules-only measure() for exactly one frozen input. Validate source/lock/harness/manifest before launch, and the actual harness configuration before scan. Forbid model transport and credentials; validate native JSON and SARIF offline. The outer300-second deadline starts before Popen and includes import, source materialization, configuration, scan, validation and writing.

Record the single consumed dispatch before invoking it, and each observation before launch. Reject GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT other than1. No retries or continuing after failure; unused observations close explicitly. The first historical job requires development completion and condition gate; the second requires the first historical gate.

Use cooperative parent termination, bounded forced process-group cleanup, Linux subreaping and the retained dummy-child controls. Keep partial outputs and raw elapsed times; cleanup does not convert a late report into a pass. Upload each job even on failure.

Download the exact first historical artifact into the second job, verify its source/input hashes and successful gate, then compare entire ordered reports recursively excluding only the listed volatile fields. Do not use the existing sorted/subset stable_report helper as whole ordered equality.
